messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Generate a vector in R
parts:
Hi:

Since this is not a ggplot2 question, it really belongs on R-help, but
here's a Q & D attempt anyway:

DF <- read.table(textConnection("

x y repeat
a b 3
c d 5

a d 3"), header = TRUE)
as.vector(unlist(apply(DF, 1, function(x) rep(x[1:2], x[3]))))

There are undoubtedly more efficient (and readable) ways to do this.

Dennis
